diagnosis.narrative: The series is dominated by a strong downward trend (a net fall of ~89% of its level). There is little seasonal structure. A few outliers stand out (762 points, ~4% of the sample). The series crosses zero, so percentage errors are unstable and mean-based combinations are safer than ratio-based ones. Across validation windows the model ranking is moderate (Kendall tau 0.353), which favours a weighted combination.
